scripts.dev: npm --workspace=shared run build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace=server run dev" "npm --workspace=web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=web run build && npm --workspace=server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=shared run build && npm --workspace=server run typecheck && npm --workspace=web run typecheck
